about: Held-out stance pairs where the mDeBERTa candidate (ml/artifacts/mdeberta-nb4) was sure (>= 0.97) and Gemini's reading differed, judged by hand by the stance step's definitions (agree: reports the same fact; disagree: same event, both cannot be true; unrelated: another event, or not enough said). 'label' is the reading judged right; eval/stanceCandidate.js uses it in place of Gemini's for these pairs.
